channel.title: Monterey County Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Monterey County Herald (montereyherald.com)

item.title: Monterey hires new parks and recreation director
item.description: Banks was selected following a recruitment process that began last fall, according to the city manager’s office. She joins Monterey from Newton, Massachusetts, where she served as commissioner of parks, recreation and culture.

item.title: Democrats visit 5-year-old detained in Minneapolis, in case that has stirred anger over ICE actions
item.description: Protesters banged drums, chanted and carried signs that included “Children are not criminals!”

item.title: Rep. Panetta introduces MOLD Act to address military housing issues
item.description: The Military Occupancy Living Defense – MOLD – Act would address hazardous conditions in military-provided housing, including prolonged mold exposure, which is associated with elevated risks of respiratory illnesses, neurological symptoms, developmental delays in children and other severe health effects.

item.title: Sheriff’s Office reports on ICE access to County Jail in 2025
item.description: According to Chief Deputy Tim Lanquist, while ICE requested access to 295 incarcerated individuals in 2025, only 21 individuals were released into ICE custody that year.

item.title: Federal troop deployments to US cities cost taxpayers $496M and counting
item.description: The Congressional Budget Office released this estimate after a request from Sen. Jeff Merkley.

item.title: Mayors warn that Trump’s hardline immigration tactics could dent trust in law enforcement
item.description: Many mayors face pressure to remove federal agents.

item.title: EPA plan would begin rolling back ‘good neighbor’ rule on downwind pollution from smokestacks
item.description: The affected states are Alabama, Arizona, Kentucky, Minnesota, Mississippi, Nevada, New Mexico and Tennessee.

item.title: Chinese national who exposed human rights abuses in his homeland is granted asylum to remain in US
item.description: Guan arrived in the U.S. illegally in 2021 and has been in custody since August.

item.title: Could Warriors be big players in Giannis trade sweepstakes?
item.description: The Warriors' future draft picks could help them get into the conversation.

item.title: Curry helps Golden State bury Utah 140-124 behind a flurry of 3-pointers
item.description: Golden State made 23 3-pointers and never trailed over the final three quarters while racking up a season-high 140 points in Utah.
